messages:
Nora (Sales): Customer wants a short-lived POC using their CloudHSM keys. Questions: can we do key-wrapping only (no KEK import), what are expected latency numbers, and what added cost for geo-replication?
Diego (AE): Need buyer-friendly line + 3-step POC plan and a procurement uplift estimate.
Priya (Infra): Buyer line: "Redwood will integrate with your HSM via an authenticated key-wrapping proxy. We do not import raw KEKs; wrapped keys and ephemeral material are used. Active-active customer-managed HSM clusters are not supported."
Priya (Infra): Latency: warmed-proxy path adds ~3-12ms typical; bad peering could push to 40ms. Rotation: metadata/key-id roll is seconds; full rewrap of stored ciphertext is hours.
Sam (Security): Security checklist (short): mTLS, no KEK persistence, audit logs to customer's SIEM, HSM creds are ephemeral. ops-bot: link -> /internal/security/byo-hsm-checklist
Priya (Infra): POC plan (3 steps): 1) network preflight and peering test; 2) deploy proxy + seed small key set; 3) run a rotation + failover drill and capture metrics. I'll attach a tiny curl harness for wrap/unwrap during demo.
Diego (AE): Procurement uplift? give a percent range we can put in the SOW.
Priya (Infra): Ballpark: +25-55% depending on replication frequency and reserved proxy sizing. I can convert to dollars if they share qps and avg token length.
Nora (Sales): Great. I'll schedule a 45m kickoff and include the checklist link and the buyer blurb. Tagging customer-sec and infra for the invite. :calendar:
